description: New York sources for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md, docs/registry/collection.md, and the review record in docs/registry/sources/ny-dos-entities.md.

sources.publisher: New York State Department of State, Division of Corporations (via Open NY, data.ny.gov)
sources.license: OPEN-NY Terms of Use (last modified 2013-03-08): a non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the Content; the terms state they impose no attribution, share-alike, re-posting or pre-approval requirements, and that so long as the use is lawful 'you may use it as you wish, subject to no other requirements'. The dataset carries no license field on the portal
sources.redistribution: Permitted (OPEN-NY terms: no attribution or share-alike requirement); public record (NY Public Officers Law art. 6, FOIL). Attribution given anyway: New York State Department of State
sources.notes: Dataset n9v6-gdp6 'Active Corporations: Beginning 1800': one row per active entity on file with the Division of Corporations (DOS ID, current entity name, initial DOS filing date, county, jurisdiction of formation, entity type, service-of-process name and address, chief executive, registered agent, principal location). Active entities only (publisher's note: 'This data does not include information on inactive corporations'). Posting frequency monthly; about 4.3 million rows; the CSV export is about 1 GB. The classic /api/views/<id>/rows.csv export is deprecated by the platform, so the v3 export URL is used. robots.txt: Crawl-delay 1; /browse?…&q= search pages disallowed, so the dataset page is used instead of a search. The OPEN-NY terms' prohibition on bots applies to the 'Public Participation' (user upload/forum) module, not to downloading published datasets, which the terms invite ('freely download and use this Content'); a person should confirm that reading. The portal platform's own terms (socrata.com) still need a human read.
